102:
Usage: %1!s! [filename=]<string>
                   [[type=]<string>]
                   [[pinpath=]<string>]
                   [[interface=]<string>]
                   [[pinned=]none|first|all]
                   [[execution=]jit|interpret]
                   [[compartment=]<integer>

Parameters:

      Tag           Value
      filename    - Filename or path to ELF file containing the
                    program.
      type        - A string used as if it were a section name, to
                    determine the program type and expected attach
                    type.
      pinpath     - Optionally the name to pin the program to.
      interface   - Optionally the friendly name or index of a
                    network interface to which an XDP program should be attached.
                    If the interface is not specified (or index is set to 0),
                    the XDP program is attached to all network interfaces.
                    The command fails if this parameter is specified for program types
                    other than XDP.
      compartment - Optionally the ID of a network compartment to which a program
                    should be attached. The command fails if this parameter is
                    specified for program types other than CGROUP_SOCK_ADDR.
      pinned      - One of the following values:
                     none: Load all programs without pinning any.
                     first: Pin the first program in the file.
                     all: Pin all programs in the file.
      execution   - One of the following values:
                     jit: Convert the program to machine code.
                     interpret: Run the program as byte code.

Remarks: Loads programs from a file and pins them if requested.
104:
Usage: %1!s! [id=]<integer>

Parameters:

      Tag         Value
      id        - ID of the program to delete.

Remarks: If the program is pinned, this unpins the specified
         program.  If an unpinned process was loaded by the same
         netsh instance, via "add program", this releases the
         reference held by netsh. If there are no other
         references to the program, it will be unloaded.
         Otherwise, the resulting message will display which
         process still holds a reference.
106:
Usage: %1!s! [id=]<integer>
                   [[attached=]<string>]
                   [[pinpath=]<string>]
                   [[interface=]<string>]

Parameters:

      Tag         Value
      id        - Program ID as shown via "show programs".
      attached  - A string used as if it were a section name, to
                  determine the attach type.  Use an empty string
                  to detach it.
      pinpath   - The name to pin the program to, or if not
                  empty, unpin the program.
      interface - Optionally the friendly name or index of a
                  network interface to which an XDP program should be attached.
                  If the interface is not specified (or index is set to 0),
                  the XDP program is attached to all network interfaces.
                  The command fails if this parameter is specified for program types
                  other than XDP.

Remarks: Pins, unpins, attaches, or detaches the specified
         program which must already be loaded.
108:
Usage: %1!s! [[type=]<string>]
                     [[attached=]any|yes|no]
                     [[pinned=]any|yes|no]
                     [[level=]normal|verbose]
                     [[filename=]<string>
                     [[section=]<string>]]
                     [[id=]<integer>]]

Parameters:

      Tag         Value
      type      - A string used as if it were a section name, to
                  determine the program type and expected attach
                  type.  If not specified, the default is xdp.
      pinned    - One of the following values:
                   any: Show all programs, pinned or not.
                        This is the default value.
                   yes: Only show pinned programs.
                   no: Only show unpinned programs.
      level     - One of the following values:
                   normal: Display one line per program.  This
                           is the default when no filename is
                           given.
                   verbose: Display extra information on each
                            program.  This is the default when a
                            filename is given.
      filename  - Filename or path to ELF file containing the
                  program.
      section   - Optionally the name of the section containing the
                  program.  If not specified, the default is to use the
                  first code section.
      id        - ID of a program to show.

Remarks: Shows all loaded programs, or those matching specified
         criteria.
109: Shows disassembly of an eBPF program.
110:
Usage: %1!s! [filename=]<string> [[section=]<string>] [[program=]<string>]

Parameters:

      Tag         Value
      filename  - Filename or path to ELF file.
      section   - Optionally the name of the section containing the
                  program.  If not specified, the default is to use the
                  first code section.
      program   - Optionally the name of the program.  If not specified,
                  the default is to use the first program.

Remarks: Shows the disassembly of the specified eBPF program.
111: Shows sections of an eBPF file.
112:
Usage: %1!s! [filename=]<string> [[section=]<string>]
                     [[level=]normal|verbose]

Parameters:

      Tag         Value
      filename  - Filename or path to .o, .dll, or .sys file.
      section   - Optionally the name of a section.
      level     - One of the following values:
                   normal: Display one line per section.  This
                           is the default when no section name is
                           given.
                   verbose: Display statistics on each section.
                            This is the default when a section
                            name is given. Statistics are only
                            shown for .o files, not .dll or .sys.

Remarks: Lists the code sections in the specified eBPF file.
113: Shows results of trying to verify an eBPF program.
114:
Usage: %1!s! [filename=]<string> [[section=]<string>] [[program=]<string>]
                     [[type=]<string>] [[level=]normal|verbose]

Parameters:

      Tag         Value
      filename  - Filename or path to ELF file.
      section   - Optionally the name of the section containing the
                  program.  If not specified, the default is to use the
                  first code section.
      program   - Optionally the name of a program.  If not specified,
                  the default is to use the first program.
      type      - A string used as if it were a section name, to
                  determine the program type and expected attach
                  type.
      level     - One of the following values:
                   normal: Only display details of errors. This is the
                           default.
                   verbose: Display details on every instruction.

Remarks: Shows the verifier results of the specified eBPF program.
